No merge-blocking findings from the prune review of 5947c78..9ebfdea.

The added structure is justified: separate jobs remove serial work; YAML anchors preserve one smoke-test implementation; xdist aggregation preserves existing session invariants. I would keep these.

Optional improvements:

  • .github/workflows/ci.yml:50: remove components: clippy, rustfmt from the Python matrix. Those checks now run in the repository-check and Rust jobs; Python lanes only build the extension.
  • .github/workflows/ci.yml:232: the host-wheel job installs the entire development group, including reference/test dependencies, although just check-wheel needs only maturin in its build environment. Its isolated smoke environments install their own dependencies. Narrowing this setup could reduce installation time, provided maturin remains selected from uv.lock.

I would not remove the apparently duplicated Clippy invocation: repository checks use default features, while Rust lanes use --all-features, so they cover different configurations.

Read-only review completed; no tests, builds, linters, edits, or external mutations. No applicable REVIEW.md found. Actual speed gains and hosted cross-compilation remain validation questions.
